objective: Find the Mate in 2 for White.

b1d3.feedback: Brilliant! You sacrifice the Queen to lure the King right into your mating net.

c1d1.feedback: Checkmate! The Rook cuts off the d-file, and your minor pieces perfectly cover the escapes.

c1c3.feedback: You just gift-wrapped your Rook for the enemy. Tragic.

c1c2.feedback: Ah, the rare 'self-mate'. You just hung your own monarch!

c1b1.feedback: Did you forget which color you're playing? You just exposed your King!

c1a1.feedback: You slid your Rook to the corner just to hang it. The King escapes.

b1a1.feedback: The bishop captures your queen. A royal tragedy.

b1a2.feedback: The bishop ignores your queen and munches your rook instead. Ouch.

b1b2.feedback: Black's pawn structure completely crushes your attack here.

b1c2.feedback: You just hung your own King! Checkmate is supposed to happen to the *other* guy.

c1c2.feedback: Illegal or fatal! You've successfully checkmated yourself.

c1c3.feedback: You just donated your Queen to charity. Very noble, very losing.

c1d1.feedback: Too weak, too slow! The enemy king is ordering a pizza while you set up.
